text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...! Haaaahhh...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of reaction is that...? 
Regardless, worrying about her is just a 
waste of time."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, you're right. 
I'm strong... strong enough to stand 
proudly alongside all of you."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—Pheeew, the hot springs were wonderful. 
...Ah, it's starting to fall."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, no wonder it felt chilly... 
I wonder if Ikuno-chan and the others are 
already asleep? I hope they're staying 
warm."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it a bit early for that? It's only 
9 o'clock. 
It's New Year's Eve, there's no harm in 
staying up."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Kyoto in the snow is beautiful, isn't 
it, Bubble-chan? 
Back during the cherry blossom season when 
I ran, the petals were fluttering down 
just like this."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I see... I'm really glad I could come. 
With you all, of all people."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Right... 
Come to think of it, you've never raced in 
Kyoto, have you?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. 
That's why I wanted to visit—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, welcome back, everyone! 
You're right on time♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Look, look! It's a 'Scenic Spot Guide'♪ 
'Enjoy Kyoto: The First Sunrise of the 
Year from the Bridge'...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It appears to be quite a distance from 
here, 
but we were just discussing how 
fascinating it sounds."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, it's gorgeous! 
But just like Ikuno-chan said... even 
taking the first train might not get us 
there in time?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! 
However... knowing full well it may be 
unreasonable, I have a request."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone. Would you aim for it together 
with me? 
The first sunrise of the year, seen from 
this spot!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...! 
Heh, to think you'd voice a wish of your 
own."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, because you pulled it off with such 
nonchalance. 
Leaping far beyond anything I could have 
ever imagined."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I just realized something. 
There's nothing the three of you can't 
do!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I agree. 
You know each other's strength better than 
anyone..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That very bond is what brought us this 
far.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If everyone who ran alongside one another 
joins hands, you can go anywhere. 
...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So, please let me ask for your advice. 
I believe in your strength! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll look into it too! 
If we split up into taxis, could we just 
barely make it in time, maybe~?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us check together. 
It gets cold at dawn, so we must check the 
temperature as well."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Fine... Ikuno... 
Hahaha! Well, after hearing that, we can't 
very well say no, can we?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"The traffic is the real bottleneck after 
all. 
Is pulling an all-nighter to save a spot 
right now our only choice...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I know! 
Why don't we just run? We are Umamusume, 
after all! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You're being far too optimistic. Running 
all night is a bit much... 
No, wait, what if we run part of the 
way...? I see! From this station...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"'—And just like that, our plan was set in 
barely an hour! 
After taking a short nap, we...!'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Brrr~~! It's so cooold! 
Being out and about in pitch darkness like 
this... It's so thrilling! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! And through back alleys, no less. 
Running really is the most versatile 
option at times like this."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get too excited and wear yourselves 
out, alright? 
Come, form a single file. We'll take turns 
acting as the windbreaker."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, I'll take the lead first! 
Everyone, follow me! Haah—!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"(...Heh. ...We really talked about some 
fond old memories. 
Whenever one of us stumbled, someone else 
was there to shine...)"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"(I know I'll 'chase after' her again... 
And I know she'll 'come after' me...)"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Because I'm certain of it—!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Good pace! ♪ Looks like we'll just barely 
make it! 
Let's keep running from here..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This way, follow me! 
I've committed the entire map to memory."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That's Air Groove for you! 
Is everyone keeping up? Alright, let's 
hurry!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"We made it...! 
Wah... Here it comes, here it comes...!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Woooaaahhhhh............!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ......I'm, at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah............ Ah... Happy New Year. 
...Wait, I hadn't said it yet, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu, you're right. Happy New Year! ♪ 
Bubble-chan takes first place again."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful I almost forgot to say 
it myself, of all things.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Always the vanguard, even this year. 
*giggle*..."

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufufufu...! 
Ahahahaha...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly lovely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there is a view that can only be 
seen 
by the three of them."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. 
Something that only those who raced 
alongside one another can understand."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(If I, too, run with all my heart through 
the racing world...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(Will I be able to form a bond like 
that... 
and create such a treasured past of my 
own, I wonder?)"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"'—I truly saw a formless, brilliant 
sparkle with my own eyes. 
Having once competed against Bubble-san 
and the others, would you understand, dear 
sister?'"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"'I shall lay down my pen for now. I've 
enclosed photos from the trip. 
May the new year be filled with hope—!'"
